title: Narrow string end pointer
summary: Recover VA 0x440a60 as a thiscall member: choose inline storage for unsigned capacity below 16, otherwise heap; add length, store endpoint, return result slot. Direct callers at 0x5c1fab and 0x5c2008 use the stored pointer as a range endpoint. No imports, allocations, validation, or pointee accesses occur.
test_description: Compare original and recovered members on the same restored object across 448 cases: eight unsigned capacities including 15/16 and high-bit values, seven lengths including wrap cases, four heap address values, external and overlapping storage output slots. Assert returned slot identity, endpoint value, full object equivalence, unchanged non-output bytes, output guards, untouched heap backing, and FS head preservation after every original call. Explicit FS installation must succeed.
known_limits: Layout and original ABI are 32-bit; Linux ports with wider pointers need a deliberate layout adaptation.
Invalid output slots or unreadable this pointers fault in the original and are not tested.
Synthetic heap addresses are used only to test arithmetic; this routine never dereferences them.
Original source-level type and symbol names are unknown; readable names describe observed behavior. No byte-matching claim.
